description: Create a Vidu task on RunAPI (reference to video). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

aspect_ratio.description: Output video aspect ratio. Declared type: string. Known values: "16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:3", "3:4".

audio.description: Generate synchronized audio. False produces a silent video. Declared type: boolean.

callback_url.description: RunAPI customer callback URL for the terminal task result. Declared type: string.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds. Declared type: integer.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_resolution.description: Output video resolution. Declared type: string. Known values: "540p", "720p", "1080p", "2k", "4k".

prompt.description: Video description, up to 20,000 characters. Declared type: string.

reference_audio_urls.description: Up to 3 HTTP(S) URLs of MP3 references, each 3 to 12 seconds and up to 50 MB. The provider validates the remote files. Declared type: array.

reference_image_urls.description: Ordered HTTP(S) URLs of 1 to 15 JPG, JPEG, PNG or WEBP reference images. The provider validates the remote files. Declared type: array.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: reference_to_video
